title: Function-preserving PicoRV32 timing/area optimization
claims: The workflow receives a content-addressed PicoRV32 baseline and an independently worded function-preserving QoR contract for one frozen configuration.
Functional, architectural, and externally cycle-visible equivalence are mandatory gates before any timing or area observation can become score eligible.
excluded_claims: The public packet does not contain upstream firmware, Dhrystone harnesses, formal harnesses, physical-flow scripts, optimized references, human solutions, or hidden evaluator assets.
The repository projection, unified development runner, PPA environment, thresholds, scoring profile, public digest, and independent admission are not frozen.

The unified runner executes visible build/simulation, RISCV_FORMAL structural projection, generic full-state sequential equivalence for the frozen configuration, bounded differential, activation, content-locked upstream workload, and unscored ORFS physical measurement in evaluator-private order. The retained development result remains incomplete because hidden-campaign freeze, repeated candidate measurement, environment/scoring freeze, independent admission, and benchmark readiness remain unavailable; equivalence does not claim that the immutable baseline is ISA-correct.
